_comment: The AtomWorks Studio release this site is built from: the atomworks-studio wheel on PyPI, whose annotation_studio/web/ directory is the browser bundle. tools/build-studio.mjs downloads that wheel, checks it against sha256 (the wheel's, as PyPI lists it) and composes index.html from it. Nothing from Studio is vendored in this repository.
_override: While `override` is set, assets/ and index.html are built from that unreleased Studio commit, not the release below: `npm run build:studio` refuses to run, and the site is rebuilt with `npm run build:studio -- --from <bundle built from override.commit>` (packages/web: pnpm install && pnpm build, then --from packages/web/dist). NOT SHIPPABLE: the commit is on a local branch of the Studio dev checkout and no Studio release contains it. Cut a Studio release, re-pin version and sha256 below, and remove `override`.

override.why: Studio's Refold panel (window.atomworksStudio.mountRefoldPanel): the refold GUI lives in Studio, this page supplies only the LocalFold-backed fold (web/refold-provider.js)
